pipelines.name: release

steps.name: set Version
steps.run:
tag=$(basename $GITHUB_REF)
if [ $tag = "master" ]; then
  tag="latest"
fi
echo "VERSION=$tag" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

steps.name: Container build and push with arm64/amd64
steps.run: IMAGE_NAMESPACE=${{ secrets.QUAYIO_ORG }} VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.VERSION }} DOCKER_PUSH=true make image-multi

if [ ${GITHUB_REF##*/} = master ]; then
 echo "VERSION=latest" >> $GITHUB_ENV
else
  echo "VERSION=${GITHUB_REF##*/}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
fi

steps.name: Install crane to get digest of image
Sign Argo Events container images and assets
steps.run:
cosign sign --yes --key env://COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY quay.io/argoproj/argo-events@${{ env.IMAGE_DIGEST }}
cosign sign-blob --yes --key env://COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY --bundle ./dist/argo-events-checksums.sig ./dist/argo-events-checksums.txt
cosign sign-blob --yes --key env://COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY --bundle /tmp/sbom.tar.gz.sig /tmp/sbom.tar.gz
# Retrieves the public key to release as an asset
cosign public-key --key env://COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY --outfile ./dist/argo-events-cosign.pub

pipelines.name: Detect and Trigger Retest

steps.name: Re-run failed jobs for this PR
steps.run:
SHA_REF=$(gh api "/repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/commits" | jq -r '.[].sha' | tail -n 1)
RUN_ID=$(gh api "repos/$REPO/actions/workflows/ci.yaml/runs?per_page=1&event=pull_request&head_sha=$SHA_REF" | jq -r '.workflow_runs[] | .id')
gh api --method POST repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/rerun-failed-jobs
